openGroupLines: Tap “＋ New session” at the bottom of the home screen and fill in name, place, time and password.
Same session every week? Tap “Repeat last session” — everything is filled in, just check the date.
inviteLines: Inside a session, “📲 Invite” has the QR code, one-tap LINE sharing and a big door poster.
Players scan, enter the password and queue themselves.
collectLines: Anyone with the password joins directly — no approval.
With “Public sign-up” on, people without the password can apply; approve them at the top of “👥 Members”. The home card shows how many are waiting.
onsiteLines: In “🏸 Courts” each card is a court: tap an empty spot to seat someone (fewest games first), tap a player to take them off.
Tap “End · next group” when a game finishes; ↩ undoes a mistake. The timer turns yellow after 20 min. Rename, lock or swap queues from ⋯.
feesLines: In “👥 Members” each person has a $ — tap when they pay; unpaid people are listed first.
“⚙️ More” has the summary, games per person and the action log; end the session at the bottom.
